source.name: PocketTorah Audio Files
source.creator: Not-a-Box Media Lab
source.sourceStyle: Avery–Binder as described by source; no independent traditional classification

algorithm.paper: Alain de Cheveigné and Hideki Kawahara, YIN, JASA 111(4), 1917–1930 (2002)
algorithm.implementation: Original fixed-window difference, cumulative mean normalization, thresholded local minimum, raw-difference parabolic interpolation. No global-minimum fallback; no step6. Not the complete published YIN algorithm. No external algorithm code copied.

parameters.method: fixed-window YIN-derived steps2–5; no global-minimum fallback or step6

algorithm.scoreMeaning: 1 minus cumulative mean normalized difference at selected lag; not a probability of a correct musical note

inputAudit.checks: Every original MP3 byte count and source SHA1 checked before decoding. Every decoded mono16bit16000HzWAV hash retained. No original MP3/PCM is altered or bundled by this import.

units.missing: Unassigned; neither silence nor a musical rest is inferred

alignment.kind: Raw recording time intersected with unchanged original word-time intervals only for370 aligned takes; exact marked reader-word guard

algorithmComparison.status: all original source byte counts/SHA1, repeated decoded PCM SHA256 and deterministic direct-difference measurements agree
algorithmComparison.limits: This checks numerical derivation from pinned original source audio, not pitch accuracy, note identities, syllable times, phonemes or cantorial/linguistic approval. Independent acoustic and musical review is pending.

review.rights: Original licensed audio and source timing attribution retained; measurements/adaptation CC BY-SA3.0

limits: F0 can be wrong by an octave or follow recording noise/other harmonics; no correction is silently applied.
No note attacks, symbolic notes, rhythms, melodic grammar, syllable times or phonemes are inferred.
Many frames fail strict thresholds and remain unassigned. Gaps are not rests.
Eight takes have unreliable source word times; no word pitch window is assigned.
Selecting pronunciation text, instrumental melody, range, transposition or tempo does not alter source measurements or recording.
This dataset is not all cantillation systems or independently styled singing. Complete requested roadmap remains active.
